findings.highlight: But try not to go too far.
findings.governingReading: He entrusts Rider to Saber but explicitly forbids deep pursuit because stopping Shinji should end the crisis.
findings.explanation: Shirou's direct order not to pursue Rider too far becomes a tentative request not to ‘go too far.’

findings.highlight: Saber rushes in to deflect the attack
findings.evidenceJa: それをライダーごと弾き返すセイバーの一撃
findings.governingReading: Rider moves to finish Shirou, and Saber's counter knocks back both the dagger and Rider herself.
findings.explanation: Saber's blow repelling Rider together with her dagger becomes Saber merely deflecting the attack.

findings.highlight: Guess I'll be at a disadvantage if go at him empty-handed!
findings.evidenceJa: さすがに手ぶらじゃ不利か
findings.governingReading: Shirou judges that attacking Shinji empty-handed would put him at a disadvantage.
findings.explanation: The clause ‘if go at him’ is missing its subject.

findings.highlight: the mop leaning against the locker there
findings.evidenceJa: このロッカーに入っているモップ
findings.governingReading: While running, Shirou identifies the long-handled mop stored in the locker as an available weapon.
findings.explanation: A mop inside the locker becomes a mop leaning against it.

findings.highlight: I pass magical energy through my body as I run.
findings.evidenceJa: 走りながら魔力を通す
findings.governingReading: After saying Trace On, he channels energy through the existing object while running and thereby Strengthens it.
findings.explanation: Shirou passing magical energy through the mop becomes passing it through his own body.

findings.highlight: maybe I just can't afford to think of anything else
findings.evidenceJa: 余分な事をするだけの体力がないのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou leaves open whether Strengthening feels natural because he has no distractions or because his injured body has no strength for superfluous action.
findings.explanation: Lacking the physical stamina to do anything extra becomes being unable to afford thinking about anything else.

findings.highlight: I use the mop to smack aside each shadow as it flies toward me.
findings.evidenceJa: 襲いかかってきた影をすべてモップで叩き斬る
findings.governingReading: Because he now has a weapon, Shirou no longer dodges and destroys all of the shadows by striking and cutting them.
findings.explanation: Cutting down every attacking shadow with the strengthened mop becomes smacking each one aside.

findings.governingReading: The isolated sound-image ‘drip’ leads into blood seeping through his clothes and dripping onto Shinji.
findings.explanation: A single drop of blood becomes blood pouring from Shirou's arm.

findings.highlight: I could snap his neck like a twig.
findings.evidenceJa: この程度の首なら、なんとか折るぐらいは出来そうだ
findings.governingReading: Magical energy makes him think that even in his condition he could somehow break a neck of this degree.
findings.explanation: Shirou's strained belief that he can probably manage to break Shinji's neck becomes snapping it ‘like a twig.’

findings.highlight: as a fellow mage, Shinji was never taught the rules of being a mage...and so didn't have any problem killing innocents
findings.evidenceJa: 相手が同じ魔術師なら、殺す事に抵抗なんてないのだと—そんな魔術師の初歩さえ、慎二は教われなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels a trace of pity because Shinji was never taught even the elementary magus rule that one has no compunction about killing a fellow magus.
findings.explanation: Shirou's lack of resistance to killing another magus is reassigned to Shinji as having no problem killing innocents.

findings.highlight: He thought he could be a mage.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師になれる、と思ったのか。
findings.governingReading: Shinji leaves the sentence unfinished, and Shirou silently supplies the possible motive as a question.
findings.explanation: Shirou's question whether Shinji thought he could become a magus becomes a flat statement that he did.

findings.highlight: No matter the opponent, they cannot match my agility.
findings.evidenceJa: たとえ相手が何者であろうと、我が疾走を妨げるコトはできない
findings.governingReading: After conceding her inferiority to Saber, Rider says no opponent can obstruct her rapid advance.
findings.explanation: Rider's assurance that nobody can stop her advance becomes a comparison of agility. Her concession to Saber and confidence in her Noble Phantasm remain.

findings.highlight: Rider will bleed out and disappear on her own.
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーは大量の血を失い、自ら消滅するだけではないのか。
findings.governingReading: Before the suspended blood reveals a ritual, he poses her apparent self-destruction as a confused prediction.
findings.explanation: Shirou wondering whether Rider will simply bleed out and disappear becomes certainty that she will.

findings.highlight: a giant lump of magical energy
findings.governingReading: The blood circle is an immense, threatening concentration of magical power that makes the earlier field look childish.
findings.explanation: A mighty mass of magical energy becomes a ‘giant lump.’

findings.highlight: I need only defeat you here.
findings.evidenceJa: ここで引導を渡すだけだ
findings.governingReading: 引導を渡す invokes administering the final rite or putting an end to Rider, marking lethal resolve under that condition.
findings.explanation: Saber saying she will finish Rider off if Rider engulfs her own Master becomes merely defeating her.

findings.evidenceJa: 肉をこじ開けるような音
findings.governingReading: Shirou compares an unidentified creaking sound to flesh being pried apart while Rider's hair rises.
findings.explanation: A sound like flesh being forced open becomes the actual sound of flesh rending.

findings.highlight: A huge bolt of light shoots down the hallway at tremendous speed.
findings.evidenceJa: 巨大な光の矢じみたものが、とてつもないスピードで廊下を駆け抜けていったのだと
findings.governingReading: Unable to see, he is forced by sensation to conclude that a white something resembling a giant light arrow raced past at tremendous speed.
findings.explanation: Shirou's eyes-closed inference that something like a huge arrow of light passed becomes a categorical bolt of light shooting down the hall.

findings.highlight: The bolt of light wasn't after us. It was probably a means of escape.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちを狙ったものではなく、あくまでここから離脱する為だけの物だったらしい
findings.governingReading: After finding Rider and Shinji gone, he infers that the light apparently served escape rather than attack.
findings.explanation: Shirou's tentative conclusion that the light was only for escape becomes certainty that it was not aimed at them.

findings.highlight: I feel a hammering in my head again.
findings.evidenceJa: 頭の中で打ち付けられていた撃鉄が戻っていく
findings.governingReading: As the crisis state ends, the previously struck gun-hammer-like mechanism in his head clicks back into place, paired with the heat in his body cooling.
findings.explanation: A gun hammer resetting in Shirou's head becomes a recurrence of generic hammering pain.
